#### Chartered Conquest
qpq_k_chartered_conquest_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_chartered_conquest_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_chartered_conquest_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_chartered_conquest_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_chartered_conquest_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_chartered_conquest_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = chartered_conquest SECRET = conquest TERM = 96 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_chartered_conquest_on_seal_effect = {
	qpq_grant_war_licence_effect = { AGENT = scope:qpq_agent TARGET = scope:qpq_target }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_is_charter }
		scope:qpq_agent = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_mandate_against target = scope:qpq_target } }
		scope:qpq_target = {
			every_realm_county = {
				limit = {
					any_this_title_or_de_jure_above = { holder ?= scope:qpq_payer }
				}
				scope:qpq_agent = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_mandate_titles target = prev } }
			}
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_chartered_conquest_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_chartered_conquest_on_end_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target }
		qpq_revoke_war_licence_effect = { AGENT = scope:qpq_agent TARGET = scope:qpq_target }
	}

	scope:qpq_agent = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_mandate_titles }
			clear_variable_list = qpq_mandate_titles
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_mandate_against }
			clear_variable_list = qpq_mandate_against
		}
		# Other Charters of the same vassal keep their Crown Mandate
		every_in_list = {
			variable = qpq_pacts
			limit = {
				qpq_story_is_active_trigger = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:qpq_story }
				var:qpq_kind = flag:chartered_conquest
				has_variable = qpq_charter
				exists = var:qpq_target
			}
			var:qpq_target = { save_scope_as = qpq_other_mandate_target }
			scope:qpq_agent = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_mandate_against target = scope:qpq_other_mandate_target } }
			var:qpq_payer = { save_scope_as = qpq_other_mandate_payer }
			scope:qpq_other_mandate_target = {
				every_realm_county = {
					limit = {
						any_this_title_or_de_jure_above = { holder ?= scope:qpq_other_mandate_payer }
					}
					scope:qpq_agent = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_mandate_titles target = prev } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_chartered_conquest_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_chartered_conquest_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_chartered_conquest_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_agent = { is_at_war = no }
			scope:qpq_target = { is_alive = yes }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 20
			qpq_ai_declare_pact_war_effect = { ATTACKER = scope:qpq_agent DEFENDER = scope:qpq_target }
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_chartered_conquest_exposed_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_chartered_conquest_ai_find_effect = {
	random_vassal = {
		limit = {
			is_landed = yes
			is_at_war = no
			any_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
				NOT = { top_liege = root.top_liege }
			}
		}
		save_scope_as = recipient
		random_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
			limit = { NOT = { top_liege = root.top_liege } }
			save_scope_as = secondary_recipient
		}
	}
}

	# The target's liege treats the war as yours
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { is_alive = yes } }
		scope:qpq_target = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_betrayed_me_opinion opinion = -30 }
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:qpq_target
			qpq_bound_by_peace_trigger = { A = scope:qpq_payer B = scope:qpq_target }
		}
		scope:qpq_payer = { add_prestige = major_prestige_loss }
	}
}

		add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_marcher_charge_modifier months = qpq_term_months_value }

		}

qpq_k_marcher_charge_ai_find_effect = {
	random_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { top_liege = root.top_liege }
			OR = {
				has_relation_rival = root
				faith = { faith_hostility_level = { target = root.faith value >= faith_hostile_level } }
			}
		}
		save_scope_as = secondary_recipient
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		random_vassal = {
			limit = {
				is_landed = yes
				any_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = { this = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
			save_scope_as = recipient
		}
	}
}

		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_payer.primary_title }
		scope:qpq_payer.primary_title = {
			every_elector = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { this = scope:qpq_agent }
					NOT = { this = scope:qpq_payer }
				}
				add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_bought_election_opinion }
			}
		}
	}

#### The Loyal Mole
qpq_k_loyal_mole_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_loyal_mole_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_loyal_mole_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_loyal_mole_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = loyal_mole SECRET = faction TERM = 72 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_loyal_mole_on_seal_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_loyal_mole_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_loyal_mole_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_loyal_mole_tick_effect = {
	qpq_record_faction_members_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_agent_in_faction }
		set_variable = qpq_mole_joined
		scope:qpq_agent.joined_faction ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { faction_discontent > 0 }
				add_faction_discontent = -2
			}
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_loyal_mole_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_loyal_mole_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = qpq_mole_joined } }
		random = {
			chance = 15
			qpq_ai_join_faction_against_payer_effect = yes
		}
	}
	else = {
		random = {
			chance = 8
			scope:qpq_agent = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = joined_faction }
					joined_faction = { add_faction_discontent = -20 }
					leave_faction = joined_faction
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_loyal_mole_exposed_effect = {
	# Faction members turn on the mole, and stop trusting each other
	scope:qpq_payer = {
		every_targeting_faction = {
			every_faction_member = {
				limit = { NOT = { this = scope:qpq_agent } }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_agent modifier = qpq_betrayer_opinion }
			}
			every_faction_member = {
				save_temporary_scope_as = qpq_mistrusting
				prev = {
					every_faction_member = {
						limit = { NOT = { this = scope:qpq_mistrusting } }
						add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_mistrusting modifier = qpq_faction_mistrust_opinion }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

#### Agent Provocateur

	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_agent_provocateur_payer_tier_value }

	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_agent_provocateur_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_agent_provocateur_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_agent_provocateur_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = agent_provocateur SECRET = faction TERM = 96 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_agent_provocateur_on_seal_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_agent_provocateur_on_deliver_effect = {
	# Crush and revoke everyone who joined
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_entrapped }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = qpq_entrapped
			limit = { is_alive = yes }
			scope:qpq_payer = {
				add_opinion = { target = prev modifier = qpq_conspirator_opinion }
			}
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_agent_provocateur_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_agent_provocateur_tick_effect = {
	qpq_record_faction_members_effect = yes
}
qpq_k_agent_provocateur_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_agent_provocateur_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = qpq_agent_in_faction } }
		random = {
			chance = 12
			qpq_ai_join_faction_against_payer_effect = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_agent = {
				is_a_faction_leader = yes
				joined_faction = { faction_is_at_war = no }
			}
		}
		random = {
			chance = 10
			scope:qpq_agent.joined_faction = { faction_start_war = {} }
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_agent_provocateur_exposed_effect = {
	qpq_entrapped_turn_on_payer_effect = yes
	scope:qpq_payer = {
		add_tyranny = 30
		every_vassal = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_plays_favourites_opinion opinion = -10 }
		}
	}
}

#### Licensed Feud
qpq_k_licensed_feud_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_licensed_feud_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_licensed_feud_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_licensed_feud_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_licensed_feud_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_licensed_feud_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = licensed_feud SECRET = conquest TERM = 72 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_licensed_feud_on_seal_effect = {
	qpq_grant_war_licence_effect = { AGENT = scope:qpq_agent TARGET = scope:qpq_target }
	scope:qpq_agent = { add_hook = { type = favor_hook target = scope:qpq_payer } }
}
qpq_k_licensed_feud_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_licensed_feud_on_end_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target }
		qpq_revoke_war_licence_effect = { AGENT = scope:qpq_agent TARGET = scope:qpq_target }
	}
}
qpq_k_licensed_feud_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_licensed_feud_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_licensed_feud_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_agent = { is_at_war = no }
			scope:qpq_target = { is_alive = yes }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 20
			qpq_ai_declare_pact_war_effect = { ATTACKER = scope:qpq_agent DEFENDER = scope:qpq_target }
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_licensed_feud_exposed_effect = {
	scope:qpq_payer = {
		every_vassal = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { this = scope:qpq_agent }
				NOT = { this = scope:qpq_target }
			}
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_plays_favourites_opinion }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { is_alive = yes } }
		scope:qpq_target = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_agent modifier = qpq_avenge_perfidy_opinion }
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_licensed_feud_ai_find_effect = {
	random_vassal = {
		limit = {
			is_landed = yes
			is_ai = yes
			any_relation = { type = rival liege ?= root is_landed = yes }
		}
		save_scope_as = recipient
		random_relation = {
			type = rival
			limit = { liege ?= root is_landed = yes }
			save_scope_as = secondary_recipient
		}
	}
}

#### Dossier
qpq_k_dossier_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_dossier_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_dossier_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_dossier_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = dossier SECRET = espionage TERM = 48 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_dossier_on_seal_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_dossier_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_dossier_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_dossier_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_dossier_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_dossier_ai_attempt_effect = {
	random = {
		chance = {
			value = 3
			add = { value = scope:qpq_agent.intrigue divide = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:qpq_target = {
					any_secret = { NOT = { is_known_by = scope:qpq_payer } }
				}
			}
			scope:qpq_target = {
				random_secret = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_known_by = scope:qpq_payer } }
					reveal_to = scope:qpq_payer
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			scope:qpq_payer = { add_hook = { type = fabrication_hook target = scope:qpq_target } }
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_dossier_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { is_alive = yes } }
		scope:qpq_target = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_betrayed_me_opinion opinion = -40 }
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_agent modifier = qpq_informer_opinion }
		}
	}
	scope:qpq_agent = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_informer_modifier years = 10 } }
}
qpq_k_dossier_ai_find_effect = {
	random_relation = {
		type = rival
		limit = { liege ?= root }
		save_scope_as = secondary_recipient
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = cp:councillor_spymaster }
			cp:councillor_spymaster = { save_scope_as = recipient }
		}
	}
}

#### Quiet Removal
qpq_k_quiet_removal_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_quiet_removal_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_quiet_removal_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_quiet_removal_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = quiet_removal SECRET = murder TERM = 60 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_quiet_removal_on_seal_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_quiet_removal_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_quiet_removal_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_quiet_removal_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_quiet_removal_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_quiet_removal_ai_attempt_effect = {
	random = {
		chance = 25
		qpq_ai_start_murder_effect = { AGENT = scope:qpq_agent TARGET = scope:qpq_target }
	}
}
qpq_k_quiet_removal_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target.killer ?= scope:qpq_agent }
		scope:qpq_agent = { add_trait = murderer }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target.house.house_head }
		scope:qpq_target.house.house_head = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_alive = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:qpq_payer }
				}
				add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_betrayed_my_house_opinion }
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target.liege ?= scope:qpq_payer }
		scope:qpq_payer = { add_tyranny = 20 }
	}
}
qpq_k_quiet_removal_ai_find_effect = {
	random_relation = {
		type = rival
		limit = { is_alive = yes }
		save_scope_as = secondary_recipient
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		random_vassal = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				intrigue >= 10
				NOT = { this = scope:secondary_recipient }
				NOT = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
			save_scope_as = recipient
		}
	}
}

#### The Cloister

	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_the_cloister_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_the_cloister_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_the_cloister_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = the_cloister SECRET = dynastic TERM = 24 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_the_cloister_on_seal_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_the_cloister_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_the_cloister_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_the_cloister_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_the_cloister_perform_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target = scope:qpq_agent }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_agent.primary_heir }
			scope:qpq_payer_secret ?= { set_variable = { name = qpq_successor value = scope:qpq_agent.primary_heir } }
		}
		scope:qpq_agent = { depose = yes }
	}
	scope:qpq_target = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_married = yes }
			every_spouse = { divorce = scope:qpq_target }
		}
		add_trait = devoted
	}
}
qpq_k_the_cloister_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_k_the_cloister_can_perform_trigger = yes }
		random = {
			chance = 25
			qpq_k_the_cloister_perform_effect = yes
			qpq_deliver_pact_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_the_cloister_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_payer_secret.var:qpq_successor }
		scope:qpq_payer_secret.var:qpq_successor = {
			if = {
				limit = { qpq_uses_legitimacy_trigger = yes }
				add_legitimacy = -20
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { is_alive = yes } }
		scope:qpq_target = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_betrayed_me_opinion opinion = -40 }
		}
	}
}

	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_marriage_by_command_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_marriage_by_command_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_marriage_by_command_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_marriage_by_command_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = marriage_by_command SECRET = dynastic TERM = 24 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_marriage_by_command_on_seal_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_marriage_by_command_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_marriage_by_command_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_marriage_by_command_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_marriage_by_command_perform_effect = {
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		every_spouse = {
			save_temporary_scope_as = qpq_discarded_spouse
			scope:qpq_payer_secret ?= { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_discarded target = scope:qpq_discarded_spouse } }
			divorce = scope:qpq_agent
		}
		marry = scope:qpq_target
	}
}
qpq_k_marriage_by_command_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_k_marriage_by_command_can_perform_trigger = yes }
		random = {
			chance = 25
			qpq_k_marriage_by_command_perform_effect = yes
			qpq_deliver_pact_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_marriage_by_command_exposed_effect = {
	scope:qpq_payer = { add_piety = medium_piety_loss }
	scope:qpq_agent = { add_piety = medium_piety_loss }
	scope:qpq_payer_secret ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_discarded }
			every_in_list = {
				variable = qpq_discarded
				house.house_head ?= {
					add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_betrayed_my_house_opinion }
					add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_agent modifier = qpq_betrayed_my_house_opinion }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

#### Hand-Over
qpq_k_hand_over_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_hand_over_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_hand_over_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_hand_over_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_hand_over_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_hand_over_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = hand_over SECRET = abduction TERM = 12 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_hand_over_on_seal_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_hand_over_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_hand_over_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_hand_over_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_hand_over_perform_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { is_imprisoned = yes } }
		qpq_hand_prisoner_to_payer_effect = yes
	}
	else = {
		scope:qpq_payer = { add_courtier = scope:qpq_target }
	}
}
qpq_k_hand_over_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_k_hand_over_can_perform_trigger = yes }
		random = {
			chance = 25
			qpq_k_hand_over_perform_effect = yes
			qpq_deliver_pact_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_hand_over_exposed_effect = {
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		every_courtier = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_agent modifier = qpq_betrayed_a_guest_opinion }
		}
	}
}

#### Renunciation
qpq_k_renunciation_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:target = { save_scope_as = qpq_target_title }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		scope:target.holder = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	}
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_renunciation_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_renunciation_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_renunciation_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = renunciation SECRET = dynastic TERM = 12 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}

#### Hush Money
qpq_k_hush_money_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_hush_money_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_hush_money_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_hush_money_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_hush_money_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_hush_money_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = hush_money SECRET = bribery TERM = 120 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_hush_money_on_seal_effect = {
	scope:qpq_payer = {
		every_secret = {
			limit = {
				is_known_by = scope:qpq_agent
				NOT = { var:qpq_story ?= scope:qpq_story }
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:qpq_hush_secret }
					OR = {
						this = scope:qpq_hush_secret
						scope:qpq_hush_secret.var:qpq_twin ?= this
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { qpq_is_pact_secret_trigger = yes }
				set_variable = qpq_cover_up
				set_variable = { name = qpq_hushed_by value = scope:qpq_agent }
			}
			else = {
				disable_exposure_by = scope:qpq_agent
			}
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_hush_money_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_hush_money_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_hush_money_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_hush_money_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_hush_money_ai_attempt_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_hush_money_exposed_effect = {
	# nothing
}

#### Blessing for a Feud
qpq_k_blessing_for_a_feud_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = blessing_for_a_feud SECRET = conquest TERM = 60 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_blessing_for_a_feud_on_seal_effect = {
	qpq_grant_war_licence_effect = { AGENT = scope:qpq_payer TARGET = scope:qpq_target }
	scope:qpq_payer = { add_hook = { type = favor_hook target = scope:qpq_agent } }
}
qpq_k_blessing_for_a_feud_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_blessing_for_a_feud_on_end_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target }
		qpq_revoke_war_licence_effect = { AGENT = scope:qpq_payer TARGET = scope:qpq_target }
	}
}
qpq_k_blessing_for_a_feud_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_blessing_for_a_feud_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_blessing_for_a_feud_ai_attempt_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_blessing_for_a_feud_exposed_effect = {
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		every_vassal = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { this = scope:qpq_payer }
				NOT = { this = scope:qpq_target }
			}
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_agent modifier = qpq_plays_favourites_opinion }
		}
	}
	scope:qpq_payer = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_known_schemer_modifier years = 8 } }
}
qpq_k_blessing_for_a_feud_ai_find_effect = {
	liege = { save_scope_as = recipient }
	random_relation = {
		type = rival
		limit = { liege ?= root.liege is_landed = yes }
		save_scope_as = secondary_recipient
	}
}

#### Clemency Bargain
qpq_k_clemency_bargain_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_clemency_bargain_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_clemency_bargain_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_clemency_bargain_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_clemency_bargain_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_clemency_bargain_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = clemency_bargain SECRET = bribery TERM = 12 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_clemency_bargain_on_seal_effect = {
	scope:qpq_payer = {
		every_known_secret = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { secret_owner = scope:qpq_payer }
				NOT = { secret_owner = scope:qpq_agent }
				NOT = { is_known_by = scope:qpq_agent }
			}
			reveal_to = scope:qpq_agent
			secret_owner = { save_scope_as = qpq_informed }
			scope:qpq_payer_secret ?= { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_informed_on target = scope:qpq_informed } }
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_clemency_bargain_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_clemency_bargain_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_clemency_bargain_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_clemency_bargain_perform_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_payer = { is_imprisoned_by = scope:qpq_agent } }
		scope:qpq_payer = { release_from_prison = yes }
	}
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_opinion_modifier = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_criminal_pact_opinion } }
			remove_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_criminal_pact_opinion }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_opinion_modifier = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_conspirator_opinion } }
			remove_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_conspirator_opinion }
		}
		add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_pardoned_opinion }
	}
}
qpq_k_clemency_bargain_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_k_clemency_bargain_can_perform_trigger = yes }
		random = {
			chance = 25
			qpq_k_clemency_bargain_perform_effect = yes
			qpq_deliver_pact_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_clemency_bargain_exposed_effect = {
	scope:qpq_payer_secret ?= {
		every_in_list = {
			variable = qpq_informed_on
			limit = { is_alive = yes }
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_informer_opinion }
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_clemency_bargain_ai_find_effect = {
	liege = { save_scope_as = recipient }
}

		add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_target modifier = qpq_bought_vote_opinion }
		recalculate_succession_election_vote = yes
	}
}
qpq_k_electoral_capitulation_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_electoral_capitulation_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}

	# nothing
}
qpq_k_electoral_capitulation_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_electoral_capitulation_ai_attempt_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_electoral_capitulation_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_payer.primary_title }
		scope:qpq_payer.primary_title = {
			every_elector = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { this = scope:qpq_agent }
					NOT = { this = scope:qpq_payer }
				}
				add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_precedent_opinion }
			}
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_electoral_capitulation_ai_find_effect = {

	if = {
		limit = { exists = liege.primary_heir }
		liege.primary_heir = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }
	}
}

#### Mutual Defense League
qpq_k_mutual_defense_league_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:actor.liege = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_mutual_defense_league_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = mutual_defense_league SECRET = faction TERM = 120 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_mutual_defense_league_on_seal_effect = {
	scope:qpq_payer = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_league_stories target = scope:qpq_story } }
}
qpq_k_mutual_defense_league_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_mutual_defense_league_on_end_effect = {
	scope:qpq_payer = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_league_stories target = scope:qpq_story } }
			remove_list_variable = { name = qpq_league_stories target = scope:qpq_story }
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_mutual_defense_league_tick_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_league_called
			scope:qpq_agent = { joined_faction ?= { faction_target = scope:qpq_target } }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_league_called
		set_variable = qpq_league_answered
	}
}
qpq_k_mutual_defense_league_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_mutual_defense_league_ai_attempt_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_mutual_defense_league_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { is_alive = yes } }
		scope:qpq_target = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_conspirator_opinion }
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_agent modifier = qpq_conspirator_opinion }
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_mutual_defense_league_ai_find_effect = {
	liege = { save_scope_as = qpq_ai_liege }
	scope:qpq_ai_liege = {
		random_vassal = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { this = root }
				is_landed = yes
				opinion = { target = scope:qpq_ai_liege value <= 0 }
			}
			save_scope_as = recipient
		}
	}
}

	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:actor.liege = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_faction_pledge_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_faction_pledge_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_faction_pledge_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_faction_pledge_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_faction_pledge_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = faction_pledge SECRET = faction TERM = 96 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_faction_pledge_on_seal_effect = {
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { exists = joined_faction }
				scope:qpq_payer = { exists = joined_faction }
			}
			join_faction_forced = {
				faction = scope:qpq_payer.joined_faction
				forced_by = scope:qpq_payer
				years = 5
			}
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_faction_pledge_on_deliver_effect = {
	scope:qpq_payer = { add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain }
	scope:qpq_agent = { add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain }
}
qpq_k_faction_pledge_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_faction_pledge_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_faction_pledge_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_faction_pledge_ai_attempt_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_faction_pledge_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { is_alive = yes } }
		scope:qpq_target = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_conspirator_opinion }
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_agent modifier = qpq_conspirator_opinion }
		}
	}
	scope:qpq_payer = {
		every_ally = { break_alliance = scope:qpq_payer }
	}
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		every_ally = { break_alliance = scope:qpq_agent }
	}
}

#### Title Swap
qpq_k_title_swap_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:target = { save_scope_as = qpq_target_title }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		scope:target.holder = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	}
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_title_swap_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_title_swap_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_title_swap_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = title_swap SECRET = dynastic TERM = 12 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_title_swap_on_seal_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_x_consent ?= yes }
		scope:qpq_payer.liege = {
			send_interface_message = {
				type = event_generic_neutral_text
				title = qpq_msg_title_swap_consent_title
				desc = qpq_msg_title_swap_consent_desc
				left_icon = scope:qpq_payer
				right_icon = scope:qpq_agent
			}
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_title_swap_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_title_swap_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_title_swap_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_title_swap_perform_effect = {
	qpq_agent_cedes_title_effect = yes
}
qpq_k_title_swap_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_k_title_swap_can_perform_trigger = yes }
		random = {
			chance = 25
			qpq_k_title_swap_perform_effect = yes
			qpq_deliver_pact_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_title_swap_exposed_effect = {
	scope:qpq_payer.liege ?= {
		add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_conspirator_opinion opinion = -15 }
	}
}
qpq_k_title_swap_ai_find_effect = {
	liege = {
		random_vassal = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { this = root }
				is_landed = yes
				any_held_title = { tier = tier_county count >= 2 }
			}
			save_scope_as = recipient
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
		scope:recipient = {
			random_held_title = {
				limit = {
					tier = tier_county
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient.capital_county }
				}
				save_scope_as = target
			}
		}
	}
}

#### Coup Pact
qpq_k_coup_pact_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:actor.liege = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_coup_pact_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_coup_pact_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_coup_pact_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_coup_pact_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_coup_pact_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = coup_pact SECRET = murder TERM = 60 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_coup_pact_on_seal_effect = {
	scope:qpq_target.primary_title ?= {
		save_scope_as = qpq_coup_title
		scope:qpq_story ?= { set_variable = { name = qpq_coup_title value = scope:qpq_coup_title } }
		scope:qpq_payer_secret ?= { set_variable = { name = qpq_coup_title value = scope:qpq_coup_title } }
	}
}
qpq_k_coup_pact_on_deliver_effect = {
	# Seize the regency: the new ruler owes the plotter
	if = {
		limit = { exists = var:qpq_coup_title.holder }
		var:qpq_coup_title.holder = { save_scope_as = qpq_new_ruler }
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:qpq_new_ruler = { is_adult = no }
			}
			scope:qpq_payer = {
				add_hook = { type = strong_favor_hook target = scope:qpq_new_ruler }
				add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain
			}
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_coup_pact_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_coup_pact_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_coup_pact_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_coup_pact_ai_attempt_effect = {
	random = {
		chance = 20
		qpq_ai_start_murder_effect = { AGENT = scope:qpq_agent TARGET = scope:qpq_target }
	}
}
qpq_k_coup_pact_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target.house.house_head }
		scope:qpq_target.house.house_head = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_alive = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:qpq_payer }
				}
				add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_betrayed_my_house_opinion }
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_payer_secret.var:qpq_coup_title.holder }
		scope:qpq_payer_secret.var:qpq_coup_title.holder = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_traitor_opinion }
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_agent modifier = qpq_traitor_opinion }
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_coup_pact_ai_find_effect = {
	liege = {
		random_courtier = {
			limit = {
				is_adult = yes
				is_ai = yes
				NOT = { this = root }
				intrigue >= 10
			}
			save_scope_as = recipient
		}
	}
}

#### Proxy War
qpq_k_proxy_war_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_proxy_war_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_proxy_war_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_proxy_war_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = proxy_war SECRET = conquest TERM = 72 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_proxy_war_on_seal_effect = {
	qpq_grant_war_licence_effect = { AGENT = scope:qpq_agent TARGET = scope:qpq_target }
}
qpq_k_proxy_war_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_proxy_war_on_end_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target }
		qpq_revoke_war_licence_effect = { AGENT = scope:qpq_agent TARGET = scope:qpq_target }
	}
}
qpq_k_proxy_war_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_proxy_war_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_proxy_war_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_agent = { is_at_war = no }
			scope:qpq_target = { is_alive = yes }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 20
			qpq_ai_declare_pact_war_effect = { ATTACKER = scope:qpq_agent DEFENDER = scope:qpq_target }
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_proxy_war_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { is_alive = yes } }
		scope:qpq_target = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_avenge_perfidy_opinion }
		}
	}
	scope:qpq_payer = {
		every_ally = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_betrayed_my_ally_opinion }
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:qpq_target
			qpq_bound_by_peace_trigger = { A = scope:qpq_payer B = scope:qpq_target }
		}
		scope:qpq_payer = { add_prestige = major_prestige_loss }
	}
}
qpq_k_proxy_war_ai_find_effect = {
	random_relation = {
		type = rival
		limit = { is_landed = yes NOT = { top_liege = root.top_liege } }
		save_scope_as = secondary_recipient
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		scope:secondary_recipient.top_liege = {
			random_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { this = root }
					is_ai = yes
					is_at_war = no
					NOT = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
				save_scope_as = recipient
			}
		}
	}
}

#### Partition Pact
qpq_k_partition_pact_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_partition_pact_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_partition_pact_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_partition_pact_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_partition_pact_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_partition_pact_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = partition_pact SECRET = conquest TERM = 96 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_partition_pact_on_seal_effect = {
	qpq_grant_war_licence_effect = { AGENT = scope:qpq_agent TARGET = scope:qpq_target }
	scope:qpq_target = {
		every_realm_county = {
			limit = { is_neighbor_to_realm = scope:qpq_payer }
			scope:qpq_story ?= { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_payer_share target = prev } }
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_partition_pact_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_partition_pact_on_end_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target }
		qpq_revoke_war_licence_effect = { AGENT = scope:qpq_agent TARGET = scope:qpq_target }
	}
}
qpq_k_partition_pact_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_partition_pact_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_partition_pact_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_agent = { is_at_war = no }
			scope:qpq_target = { is_alive = yes }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 20
			qpq_ai_declare_pact_war_effect = { ATTACKER = scope:qpq_agent DEFENDER = scope:qpq_target }
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_partition_pact_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { is_alive = yes } }
		scope:qpq_target = {
			every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { this = scope:qpq_payer }
					NOT = { this = scope:qpq_agent }
				}
				add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_target modifier = qpq_feared_partition_opinion }
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:qpq_target
			qpq_bound_by_peace_trigger = { A = scope:qpq_payer B = scope:qpq_target }
		}
		scope:qpq_payer = { add_prestige = major_prestige_loss }
	}
}

#### Bought Truce
qpq_k_bought_truce_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_bought_truce_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_bought_truce_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_bought_truce_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_bought_truce_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_bought_truce_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = bought_truce SECRET = bribery TERM = 60 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_bought_truce_on_seal_effect = {
	scope:qpq_payer = {
		every_character_war = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { is_attacker = scope:qpq_payer is_defender = scope:qpq_agent }
					AND = { is_defender = scope:qpq_payer is_attacker = scope:qpq_agent }
				}
			}
			end_war = white_peace
		}
		add_truce_both_ways = {
			character = scope:qpq_agent
			name = qpq_truce_name
			months = qpq_term_months_value
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_bought_truce_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_bought_truce_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_bought_truce_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_bought_truce_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_bought_truce_ai_attempt_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_bought_truce_exposed_effect = {
	scope:qpq_payer = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_easy_mark_modifier years = 10 } }
}
qpq_k_bought_truce_ai_find_effect = {
	random_character_war = {
		limit = {
			is_defender = root
			primary_attacker = { is_ai = yes }
		}
		primary_attacker = { save_scope_as = recipient }
	}
}

#### Faithless Ally
qpq_k_faithless_ally_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_faithless_ally_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_faithless_ally_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_faithless_ally_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = faithless_ally SECRET = betrayal TERM = 60 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_faithless_ally_on_seal_effect = {
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		every_character_war = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = { is_attacker = scope:qpq_agent is_defender = scope:qpq_payer }
					AND = { is_defender = scope:qpq_agent is_attacker = scope:qpq_payer }
				}
				NOR = {
					primary_attacker = scope:qpq_agent
					primary_defender = scope:qpq_agent
				}
			}
			remove_participant = scope:qpq_agent
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_faithless_ally_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_faithless_ally_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_faithless_ally_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_faithless_ally_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_faithless_ally_ai_attempt_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_faithless_ally_exposed_effect = {
	scope:qpq_agent = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_faithless_modifier years = 10 } }
}
qpq_k_faithless_ally_ai_find_effect = {
	random_character_war = {
		limit = {
			OR = { is_attacker = root is_defender = root }
		}
		random_war_participant = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				NOT = { this = root }
				NOT = { top_liege = root.top_liege }
				is_independent_ruler = yes
				any_ally = { is_at_war_with = root }
			}
			save_scope_as = recipient
			random_ally = {
				limit = { is_at_war_with = root }
				save_scope_as = secondary_recipient
			}
		}
	}
}

#### Turncoat
qpq_k_turncoat_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:recipient.liege = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_turncoat_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_turncoat_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_turncoat_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_turncoat_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_turncoat_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = turncoat SECRET = betrayal TERM = 24 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_turncoat_on_seal_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_turncoat_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_turncoat_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_turncoat_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_turncoat_perform_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_agent = { is_landed = yes } }
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = independency
			save_scope_as = qpq_turn_change
			add_claim_on_loss = no
		}
		scope:qpq_agent = { becomes_independent = { change = scope:qpq_turn_change } }
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:qpq_turn_change
		scope:qpq_payer = {
			random_character_war = {
				limit = {
					is_attacker = scope:qpq_payer
					is_defender = scope:qpq_target
				}
				add_attacker = scope:qpq_agent
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		scope:qpq_payer = { add_courtier = scope:qpq_agent }
	}
}
qpq_k_turncoat_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_k_turncoat_can_perform_trigger = yes }
		random = {
			chance = 25
			qpq_k_turncoat_perform_effect = yes
			qpq_deliver_pact_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_turncoat_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target.house.house_head }
		scope:qpq_target.house.house_head = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_alive = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:qpq_payer }
				}
				add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_betrayed_my_house_opinion }
			}
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_turncoat_ai_find_effect = {
	random_character_war = {
		limit = { is_attacker = root }
		primary_defender = {
			random_vassal = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = yes
					opinion = { target = prev value <= 0 }
				}
				save_scope_as = recipient
			}
		}
	}
}

#### Seed the Separatists
qpq_k_seed_the_separatists_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:recipient.liege = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_seed_the_separatists_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = seed_the_separatists SECRET = faction TERM = 120 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_seed_the_separatists_on_seal_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_seed_the_separatists_on_deliver_effect = {
	qpq_victors_justice_effect = yes
}
qpq_k_seed_the_separatists_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_seed_the_separatists_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_seed_the_separatists_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_seed_the_separatists_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_agent = {
				NOT = { exists = joined_faction }
				can_create_faction = { type = independence_faction target = scope:qpq_target }
			}
		}
		random = {
			chance = 15
			scope:qpq_agent = { create_faction = { type = independence_faction target = scope:qpq_target } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_agent = { exists = joined_faction } }
		scope:qpq_agent.joined_faction = { add_faction_discontent = 2 }
	}
}
qpq_k_seed_the_separatists_exposed_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_seed_the_separatists_ai_find_effect = {
	random_relation = {
		type = rival
		limit = { is_independent_ruler = yes NOT = { this = root } }
		save_scope_as = qpq_ai_rival
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_ai_rival }
		scope:qpq_ai_rival = {
			random_vassal = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = yes
					highest_held_title_tier >= tier_duchy
					opinion = { target = scope:qpq_ai_rival value <= 0 }
				}
				save_scope_as = recipient
			}
		}
	}
}

		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }

	}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_agent = { is_landed = no NOT = { is_courtier_of = scope:qpq_payer } } }
		scope:qpq_payer = { add_courtier = scope:qpq_agent }
	}

		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_buy_a_councillor_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = buy_a_councillor SECRET = espionage TERM = 48 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_buy_a_councillor_on_seal_effect = {
	scope:qpq_target = {
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_council_sabotage_modifier months = qpq_term_months_value }
	}
}
qpq_k_buy_a_councillor_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_buy_a_councillor_on_end_effect = {
	scope:qpq_target = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_character_modifier = qpq_council_sabotage_modifier }
			remove_character_modifier = qpq_council_sabotage_modifier
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_buy_a_councillor_tick_effect = {
	random = {
		chance = 8
		scope:qpq_target = {
			random_secret = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_known_by = scope:qpq_payer } }
				reveal_to = scope:qpq_payer
			}
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_buy_a_councillor_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_buy_a_councillor_ai_attempt_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_buy_a_councillor_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { is_alive = yes } }
		scope:qpq_target = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_agent modifier = qpq_spied_for_a_foreigner_opinion }
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_avenge_perfidy_opinion }
			if = {
				limit = { scope:qpq_agent = { is_councillor_of = scope:qpq_target } }
				fire_councillor = scope:qpq_agent
			}
		}
	}
}

#### Defection Pact
qpq_k_defection_pact_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }

	}

		limit = {
			qpq_defection_pact_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_defection_pact_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = defection_pact SECRET = betrayal TERM = 96 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_defection_pact_on_seal_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_defection_pact_on_deliver_effect = {
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = swear_fealty
		save_scope_as = qpq_defect_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:qpq_payer
			change = scope:qpq_defect_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:qpq_defect_change
	qpq_victors_justice_effect = yes
}
qpq_k_defection_pact_on_end_effect = {
	# The war was lost: the defector's treason is laid bare to their liege
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:qpq_closed ?= flag:breached
			exists = scope:qpq_agent_secret
			scope:qpq_target = { is_alive = yes }
		}
		scope:qpq_agent_secret = { reveal_to = scope:qpq_target }
	}
}
qpq_k_defection_pact_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_defection_pact_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_defection_pact_ai_attempt_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_defection_pact_exposed_effect = {
	# nothing
}

	qpq_hired_blade_attempt_effect = { AGENT = scope:qpq_agent TARGET = scope:qpq_target }
}
qpq_k_hire_the_hashashin_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target.house.house_head }
		scope:qpq_target.house.house_head = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_alive = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:qpq_payer }
				}
				add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_betrayed_my_house_opinion }
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target.faith.religious_head }
		scope:qpq_target.faith.religious_head = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_betrayed_me_opinion opinion = -30 }
		}
	}
}

#### Excommunication for Hire
qpq_k_excommunication_for_hire_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_excommunication_for_hire_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_excommunication_for_hire_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = excommunication_for_hire SECRET = simony TERM = 24 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_excommunication_for_hire_on_seal_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_excommunication_for_hire_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_excommunication_for_hire_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_excommunication_for_hire_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_excommunication_for_hire_perform_effect = {
	excommunicate_character = {
		REQUESTING_CHARACTER = scope:qpq_agent
		EXCOMMUNICATOR = scope:qpq_agent
		TARGET_CHARACTER = scope:qpq_target
	}
}
qpq_k_excommunication_for_hire_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_k_excommunication_for_hire_can_perform_trigger = yes }
		random = {
			chance = 25
			qpq_k_excommunication_for_hire_perform_effect = yes
			qpq_deliver_pact_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_excommunication_for_hire_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
		scope:qpq_target = { remove_trait = excommunicated }
	}
}

#### Dispensation for Gold

		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_dispensation_for_gold_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = dispensation_for_gold SECRET = simony TERM = 24 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_dispensation_for_gold_on_seal_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_dispensation_for_gold_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_dispensation_for_gold_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_dispensation_for_gold_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_dispensation_for_gold_perform_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { is_spouse_of = scope:qpq_payer } }
		scope:qpq_payer = { divorce = scope:qpq_target }
	}
	else = {
		scope:qpq_target = {
			remove_trait = bastard
			add_trait = legitimized_bastard
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_dispensation_for_gold_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_k_dispensation_for_gold_can_perform_trigger = yes }
		random = {
			chance = 25
			qpq_k_dispensation_for_gold_perform_effect = yes
			qpq_deliver_pact_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_dispensation_for_gold_exposed_effect = {
	scope:qpq_payer = { add_piety = medium_piety_loss }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { has_trait = legitimized_bastard } }
		scope:qpq_target = {
			remove_trait = legitimized_bastard
			add_trait = bastard
		}
	}
}

#### Steer the Holy War
qpq_k_steer_the_holy_war_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_steer_the_holy_war_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_steer_the_holy_war_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_steer_the_holy_war_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_steer_the_holy_war_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_steer_the_holy_war_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = steer_the_holy_war SECRET = simony TERM = 120 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_steer_the_holy_war_on_seal_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_steer_the_holy_war_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_steer_the_holy_war_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_steer_the_holy_war_tick_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ghw_steered }
			exists = scope:qpq_agent.faith.great_holy_war
			exists = scope:qpq_target.primary_title
			scope:qpq_target.primary_title = { tier >= tier_kingdom }
		}
		scope:qpq_agent.faith.great_holy_war = {
			set_great_holy_war_target = {
				target_title = scope:qpq_target.primary_title
				target_character = scope:qpq_target
			}
		}
		set_variable = qpq_ghw_steered
	}
}
qpq_k_steer_the_holy_war_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_steer_the_holy_war_ai_attempt_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_steer_the_holy_war_exposed_effect = {
	scope:qpq_agent.faith = {
		every_faith_holy_order = {
			leader ?= {
				add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_clergy_scandal_opinion }
			}
		}
	}
}

#### Purchase a Mitre
qpq_k_purchase_a_mitre_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_purchase_a_mitre_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_purchase_a_mitre_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = purchase_a_mitre SECRET = simony TERM = 36 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_purchase_a_mitre_on_seal_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_purchase_a_mitre_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_purchase_a_mitre_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_purchase_a_mitre_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_purchase_a_mitre_perform_effect = {
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		random_held_title = {
			limit = {
				tier = tier_barony
				is_capital_barony = no
				title_province ?= { has_holding_type = church_holding }
			}
			save_scope_as = qpq_mitre
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_mitre }
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = granted
			save_scope_as = qpq_mitre_change
			add_claim_on_loss = no
		}
		scope:qpq_mitre = {
			change_title_holder = {
				holder = scope:qpq_target
				change = scope:qpq_mitre_change
			}
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:qpq_mitre_change
		scope:qpq_payer_secret ?= { set_variable = { name = qpq_mitre_title value = scope:qpq_mitre } }
	}
	scope:qpq_target = {
		add_piety = medium_piety_gain
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_bought_mitre_modifier years = 20 }
	}
}
qpq_k_purchase_a_mitre_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_k_purchase_a_mitre_can_perform_trigger = yes }
		random = {
			chance = 25
			qpq_k_purchase_a_mitre_perform_effect = yes
			qpq_deliver_pact_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_purchase_a_mitre_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { has_character_modifier = qpq_bought_mitre_modifier } }
		scope:qpq_target = { remove_character_modifier = qpq_bought_mitre_modifier }
	}
	scope:qpq_payer = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_clerical_denunciation_modifier years = 10 } }
	# The holder may be deposed: the bought see returns to the head of faith
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:qpq_payer_secret.var:qpq_mitre_title
			scope:qpq_payer_secret.var:qpq_mitre_title.holder ?= scope:qpq_target
			scope:qpq_agent = { is_alive = yes is_landed = yes }
		}
		scope:qpq_payer_secret.var:qpq_mitre_title = { save_scope_as = qpq_lost_mitre }
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = revoked
			save_scope_as = qpq_mitre_revoke
			add_claim_on_loss = no
		}
		scope:qpq_lost_mitre = {
			change_title_holder = {
				holder = scope:qpq_agent
				change = scope:qpq_mitre_revoke
			}
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:qpq_mitre_revoke
	}
}

	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }

	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_bought_claim_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_bought_claim_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_bought_claim_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_bought_claim_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = bought_claim SECRET = simony TERM = 24 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}

qpq_k_bought_claim_on_seal_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_bought_claim_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_bought_claim_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_bought_claim_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_bought_claim_perform_effect = {
	scope:qpq_payer = { add_unpressed_claim = scope:qpq_target.primary_title }
	scope:qpq_payer_secret ?= { set_variable = { name = qpq_bought_claim_title value = scope:qpq_target.primary_title } }
}
qpq_k_bought_claim_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_k_bought_claim_can_perform_trigger = yes }
		random = {
			chance = 25
			qpq_k_bought_claim_perform_effect = yes
			qpq_deliver_pact_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_bought_claim_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:qpq_payer_secret.var:qpq_bought_claim_title
			scope:qpq_payer = { has_claim_on = scope:qpq_payer_secret.var:qpq_bought_claim_title }
		}
		scope:qpq_payer = { remove_claim = scope:qpq_payer_secret.var:qpq_bought_claim_title }
	}
}
qpq_k_bought_claim_ai_find_effect = {
	faith.religious_head = { save_scope_as = recipient }
	random_relation = {
		type = rival
		limit = { is_landed = yes }
		save_scope_as = secondary_recipient
	}
}

		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_holy_warrant_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_holy_warrant_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_holy_warrant_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = holy_warrant SECRET = simony TERM = 60 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_holy_warrant_on_seal_effect = {
	qpq_grant_war_licence_effect = { AGENT = scope:qpq_agent TARGET = scope:qpq_target }
}
qpq_k_holy_warrant_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_holy_warrant_on_end_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target }
		qpq_revoke_war_licence_effect = { AGENT = scope:qpq_agent TARGET = scope:qpq_target }
	}
}
qpq_k_holy_warrant_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_holy_warrant_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_holy_warrant_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_agent = { is_at_war = no }
			scope:qpq_target = { is_alive = yes }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 20
			qpq_ai_declare_pact_war_effect = { ATTACKER = scope:qpq_agent DEFENDER = scope:qpq_target }
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_holy_warrant_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { is_alive = yes } }
		scope:qpq_target = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_avenge_perfidy_opinion }
		}
	}
	scope:qpq_payer = {
		every_ally = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_betrayed_my_ally_opinion }
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:qpq_target
			qpq_bound_by_peace_trigger = { A = scope:qpq_payer B = scope:qpq_target }
		}
		scope:qpq_payer = { add_prestige = major_prestige_loss }
	}
}

	else = {
		scope:qpq_target = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_papal_condemnation_modifier years = 10 } }

		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { has_character_modifier = qpq_papal_condemnation_modifier } }
		scope:qpq_target = { remove_character_modifier = qpq_papal_condemnation_modifier }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_payer = { has_character_modifier = qpq_papal_favour_modifier } }
		scope:qpq_payer = { remove_character_modifier = qpq_papal_favour_modifier }
	}

#### Conclave Votes
qpq_k_conclave_votes_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_conclave_votes_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_conclave_votes_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_conclave_votes_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_conclave_votes_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_conclave_votes_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = conclave_votes SECRET = simony TERM = 120 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_conclave_votes_on_seal_effect = {
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		set_variable = {
			name = pam_forced_papal_vote_target
			value = scope:qpq_target
			years = 20
		}
		recalculate_succession_election_vote = yes
	}
}

	# nothing
}

	# nothing

	# nothing
}

	# nothing
}
qpq_k_conclave_votes_ai_attempt_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_conclave_votes_exposed_effect = {

		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes } }
		scope:qpq_target = {
			add_piety = major_piety_loss
			add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_bought_legitimacy_modifier years = 15 }
		}
		scope:qpq_target.faith = {
			change_fervor = {
				value = -10
				desc = qpq_fervor_pact_exposed
			}
		}
	}
}

	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_name_in_the_khutba_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_name_in_the_khutba_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = name_in_the_khutba SECRET = rites TERM = 24 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_name_in_the_khutba_on_seal_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_name_in_the_khutba_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_name_in_the_khutba_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_name_in_the_khutba_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_name_in_the_khutba_perform_effect = {
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_khutba_read_modifier years = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { faith = scope:qpq_payer.faith } }
			set_character_faith = scope:qpq_payer.faith
		}
	}
	scope:qpq_payer = { add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain }
	scope:qpq_target = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_khutba_slighted_modifier years = 5 } }
}
qpq_k_name_in_the_khutba_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_k_name_in_the_khutba_can_perform_trigger = yes }
		random = {
			chance = 25
			qpq_k_name_in_the_khutba_perform_effect = yes
			qpq_deliver_pact_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_name_in_the_khutba_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { is_alive = yes } }
		scope:qpq_target = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_agent modifier = qpq_traitor_opinion }
		}
	}
}

		every_relation = {

			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_bought_legitimacy_opinion }
		}
	}
}

#### Temple Patronage

	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_temple_patronage_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_temple_patronage_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_temple_patronage_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = temple_patronage SECRET = rites TERM = 12 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}

	# nothing

	# nothing
