	# nothing
}
qpq_k_temple_patronage_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_temple_patronage_perform_effect = {
	scope:qpq_payer = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_clerical_backing_modifier years = 10 } }
	scope:qpq_target = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_clerical_denunciation_modifier years = 5 } }
}
qpq_k_temple_patronage_ai_attempt_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_k_temple_patronage_can_perform_trigger = yes }
		random = {
			chance = 25
			qpq_k_temple_patronage_perform_effect = yes
			qpq_deliver_pact_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_temple_patronage_exposed_effect = {
	scope:qpq_payer = { add_piety = minor_piety_loss }
}

#### Make Peace
qpq_k_make_peace_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_make_peace_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_make_peace_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_make_peace_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_make_peace_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_make_peace_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = make_peace SECRET = bribery TERM = 12 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_make_peace_on_seal_effect = {
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		random_character_war = {
			limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:qpq_agent FOE = scope:qpq_target } }
			save_scope_as = qpq_target_war
		}
	}

	scope:qpq_target_war ?= { end_war = white_peace }
}
qpq_k_make_peace_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_make_peace_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_make_peace_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_make_peace_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_make_peace_ai_attempt_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_make_peace_exposed_effect = {
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		every_ally = {
			limit = { NOT = { this = scope:qpq_payer } }
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_agent modifier = qpq_betrayed_my_ally_opinion }
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_make_peace_ai_find_effect = {
	random_character_war = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				primary_attacker = root
				primary_defender = root
			}
			NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = root SCORE = -15 } }
		}
		save_scope_as = qpq_ai_war
		if = {
			limit = { primary_attacker = root }
			primary_defender = { save_scope_as = qpq_ai_foe }
		}
		else = {
			primary_attacker = { save_scope_as = qpq_ai_foe }
		}
	}

	scope:qpq_ai_foe ?= { save_scope_as = recipient }
	root = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }
}

#### Yield the War
qpq_k_yield_war_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_yield_war_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_yield_war_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_yield_war_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_yield_war_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_yield_war_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = yield_war SECRET = betrayal TERM = 12 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_yield_war_on_seal_effect = {
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		random_character_war = {
			limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:qpq_agent FOE = scope:qpq_target } }
			save_scope_as = qpq_target_war
		}
	}

	scope:qpq_target_war ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_attacker = scope:qpq_agent }
			end_war = defender
		}
		else = {
			end_war = attacker
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_yield_war_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_yield_war_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_yield_war_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_yield_war_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_yield_war_ai_attempt_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_yield_war_exposed_effect = {
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_faithless_modifier years = 10 }
		every_ally = {
			limit = { NOT = { this = scope:qpq_payer } }
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_agent modifier = qpq_betrayed_my_ally_opinion }
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_yield_war_ai_find_effect = {
	random_character_war = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				primary_attacker = root
				primary_defender = root
			}
			qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = root SCORE = 30 }
		}
		save_scope_as = qpq_ai_war
		if = {
			limit = { primary_attacker = root }
			primary_defender = { save_scope_as = qpq_ai_foe }
		}
		else = {
			primary_attacker = { save_scope_as = qpq_ai_foe }
		}
	}

	scope:qpq_ai_foe ?= { save_scope_as = recipient }
	root = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }
}

#### Join the War
qpq_k_join_war_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_join_war_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_join_war_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_join_war_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = join_war SECRET = conquest TERM = 60 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_join_war_on_seal_effect = {
	scope:qpq_payer = {
		random_character_war = {
			limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:qpq_payer FOE = scope:qpq_target } }
			save_scope_as = qpq_target_war
		}
	}

	scope:qpq_target_war ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_participant = scope:qpq_agent } }
			if = {
				limit = { is_attacker = scope:qpq_payer }
				add_attacker = scope:qpq_agent
			}
			else = {
				add_defender = scope:qpq_agent
			}
			scope:qpq_story ?= {
				set_variable = { name = qpq_target_war value = scope:qpq_target_war }
				set_variable = qpq_war_joined
			}
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_join_war_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_join_war_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_join_war_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_join_war_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_join_war_ai_attempt_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_join_war_exposed_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_join_war_ai_find_effect = {
	random_character_war = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				primary_attacker = root
				primary_defender = root
			}
			NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = root SCORE = 25 } }
		}
		save_scope_as = qpq_ai_war
		if = {
			limit = { primary_attacker = root }
			primary_defender = { save_scope_as = qpq_ai_foe }
		}
		else = {
			primary_attacker = { save_scope_as = qpq_ai_foe }
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_ai_foe }
		scope:qpq_ai_foe = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }
		random_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { this = scope:secondary_recipient }
				is_at_war = no
				NOT = { top_liege = scope:secondary_recipient.top_liege }
				NOT = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient }
				NOT = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient }
				opinion = { target = root value >= -10 }
			}
			save_scope_as = recipient
		}
	}
}

#### Leave the War
qpq_k_leave_war_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_leave_war_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_leave_war_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_leave_war_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_leave_war_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_leave_war_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = leave_war SECRET = betrayal TERM = 12 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_leave_war_on_seal_effect = {
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		random_character_war = {
			limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:qpq_agent FOE = scope:qpq_target } }
			save_scope_as = qpq_target_war
		}
	}

	scope:qpq_target_war ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_participant = scope:qpq_agent }
			remove_participant = scope:qpq_agent
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_leave_war_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_leave_war_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_leave_war_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_leave_war_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_leave_war_ai_attempt_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_leave_war_exposed_effect = {
	scope:qpq_agent = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = qpq_faithless_modifier years = 10 } }
}
qpq_k_leave_war_ai_find_effect = {
	random_character_war = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				primary_attacker = root
				primary_defender = root
			}

		}
		save_scope_as = qpq_ai_war
		if = {
			limit = { primary_attacker = root }
			primary_defender = { save_scope_as = qpq_ai_foe }
		}
		else = {
			primary_attacker = { save_scope_as = qpq_ai_foe }
		}
	}

	scope:qpq_ai_war ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { primary_attacker = root }
			random_war_defender = {
				limit = { NOT = { this = scope:qpq_ai_war.primary_defender } }
				save_scope_as = recipient
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_war_attacker = {
				limit = { NOT = { this = scope:qpq_ai_war.primary_attacker } }
				save_scope_as = recipient
			}
		}
	}
	root = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }
}

#### Stay Out of the War
qpq_k_stay_out_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:secondary_recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_stay_out_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_stay_out_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_stay_out_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_stay_out_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_stay_out_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = stay_out SECRET = betrayal TERM = 36 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_stay_out_on_seal_effect = {
	scope:qpq_payer = {
		random_character_war = {
			limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:qpq_payer FOE = scope:qpq_target } }
			save_scope_as = qpq_target_war
		}
	}

	scope:qpq_story ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target_war }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_target_war value = scope:qpq_target_war }
			set_variable = qpq_war_watched
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_stay_out_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_stay_out_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_stay_out_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_stay_out_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_stay_out_ai_attempt_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_stay_out_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { is_alive = yes } }
		scope:qpq_target = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_agent modifier = qpq_betrayed_me_opinion opinion = -20 }
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_stay_out_ai_find_effect = {
	random_character_war = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				primary_attacker = root
				primary_defender = root
			}

		}
		save_scope_as = qpq_ai_war
		if = {
			limit = { primary_attacker = root }
			primary_defender = { save_scope_as = qpq_ai_foe }
		}
		else = {
			primary_attacker = { save_scope_as = qpq_ai_foe }
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_ai_foe }
		scope:qpq_ai_foe = {
			save_scope_as = secondary_recipient
			random_ally = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { this = root }
					NOT = { is_at_war_with = root }
					NOT = { scope:qpq_ai_war = { is_participant = prev } }
				}
				save_scope_as = recipient
			}
		}
	}
}

#### Heavier Tribute
qpq_k_heavier_tribute_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_heavier_tribute_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_heavier_tribute_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_heavier_tribute_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_heavier_tribute_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_heavier_tribute_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }

	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = heavier_tribute SECRET = bribery TERM = 12 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_heavier_tribute_on_seal_effect = {
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_tributary_of = scope:qpq_payer }
			if = {
				limit = { vassal_contract_obligation_level:default_tributary_taxes = 0 }
				tributary_contract_set_obligation_level = { type = default_tributary_taxes level = 1 }
			}
		else_if = {
			limit = { vassal_contract_obligation_level:default_tributary_taxes = 1 }
			tributary_contract_set_obligation_level = { type = default_tributary_taxes level = 2 }
		}
		}
	}
}

	# nothing

	# nothing

#### Bought Freedom
qpq_k_bought_freedom_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_bought_freedom_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_bought_freedom_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_bought_freedom_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_bought_freedom_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_bought_freedom_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = bought_freedom SECRET = bribery TERM = 12 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_bought_freedom_on_seal_effect = {
	scope:qpq_payer = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_tributary_of = scope:qpq_agent }
			end_tributary = yes
			add_truce_both_ways = {
				character = scope:qpq_agent
				years = 5
				override = yes
				name = TRUCE_TRIBUTARY_STOPPED
			}
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_agent modifier = tributary_released_opinion opinion = 25 }
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_bought_freedom_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_bought_freedom_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}

	# nothing

	# nothing

#### Accept the Yoke
qpq_k_accept_the_yoke_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_accept_the_yoke_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_accept_the_yoke_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_accept_the_yoke_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_accept_the_yoke_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_accept_the_yoke_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = accept_the_yoke SECRET = bribery TERM = 12 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_accept_the_yoke_on_seal_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_agent = {
				is_tributary = no
				can_be_tributary_of = scope:qpq_payer
			}
		}
		start_tributary_interaction_effect = { TRIBUTARY = scope:qpq_agent SUZERAIN = scope:qpq_payer }
	}
}
qpq_k_accept_the_yoke_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_accept_the_yoke_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_accept_the_yoke_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_accept_the_yoke_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_accept_the_yoke_ai_attempt_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_accept_the_yoke_exposed_effect = {
	# nothing
}

#### Cast Off the Yoke
qpq_k_cast_off_the_yoke_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	scope:recipient.suzerain = { save_scope_as = qpq_target }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = cast_off_the_yoke SECRET = betrayal TERM = 12 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_cast_off_the_yoke_on_seal_effect = {
	scope:qpq_agent = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_tributary = yes }
			end_tributary = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_target }
		scope:qpq_target = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_agent modifier = tributary_ceased_payments_opinion opinion = -60 }
		}
	}
}
qpq_k_cast_off_the_yoke_on_deliver_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_cast_off_the_yoke_on_end_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_cast_off_the_yoke_tick_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_cast_off_the_yoke_perform_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_cast_off_the_yoke_ai_attempt_effect = {
	# nothing
}
qpq_k_cast_off_the_yoke_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_target = { is_alive = yes } }
		scope:qpq_target = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:qpq_payer modifier = qpq_betrayed_me_opinion opinion = -40 }
		}
	}
}

#### Exchange of Goods
qpq_k_barter_seal_from_scopes_effect = {
	scope:actor = { save_scope_as = qpq_payer }
	scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = qpq_agent }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_payer_tier value = qpq_barter_payer_tier_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_agent_tier value = qpq_barter_agent_tier_value }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:qpq_price } }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_barter_price_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			qpq_barter_payer_tier_value <= 0
			qpq_barter_agent_tier_value <= 0
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_floor_zero value = yes }
	}
	qpq_seal_pact_effect = { KIND = barter SECRET = exchange TERM = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_floor_zero }
		scope:qpq_story = { set_variable = qpq_floor0 }
	}
}
qpq_k_barter_on_seal_effect = {
	# nothing
}

qpq_ai_propose_kind_effect = {
	clear_saved_scope = recipient
	clear_saved_scope = secondary_recipient
	clear_saved_scope = target
	clear_saved_scope = qpq_ai_war
	clear_saved_scope = qpq_ai_foe
	clear_saved_scope = qpq_deal_command
	clear_saved_scope = qpq_cmd_bonus
	clear_saved_scope = qpq_proposed_kind
	save_scope_as = actor
	qpq_k_$KIND$_ai_find_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:recipient
			qpq_k_$KIND$_ai_target_ok_trigger = yes
			NOT = { scope:recipient = scope:actor }
			scope:recipient = { qpq_ai_target_ok_trigger = yes }
			qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient } }
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_proposed_kind value = flag:$KIND$ }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_gold value = yes }
		# AI proposers pay on delivery: if they cannot pay then, the deal sours into a breach
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_on_delivery value = yes }
		# What to offer: what the other side would need to agree (the fair price at least), worked out from
		# what they would say to no gold at all. Whether that is worth paying is the proposer's own question,
		# answered below by its own lights.
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = 0 }
		save_scope_value_as = {
			name = qpq_ai_need
			value = {
				value = qpq_$KIND$_ai_acceptance_value
				multiply = -1
				add = 2
				min = 0
				divide = {
					value = 5
					multiply = qpq_$KIND$_gold_mult_value
				}
				multiply = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
				if = {
					limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
					divide = 1.3
				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
					divide = 0.8
				}
				min = qpq_$KIND$_price_value
				round = yes
			}
		}
		clear_saved_scope = qpq_price
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = scope:qpq_ai_need }
		clear_saved_scope = qpq_ai_need
	}
	# Only what is worth its price to the one proposing, by its own lights: what it gets against what it pays
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:qpq_proposed_kind
			NOT = { qpq_$KIND$_proposer_view_value > 0 }
		}
		clear_saved_scope = qpq_proposed_kind
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_proposed_kind }
		# A liege who would be refused may lean on their authority (Command), if their standing allows it: the
		# lightest touch that will do. A person is told, and decides for themselves.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { qpq_$KIND$_ai_acceptance_value > 0 } }
			qpq_ai_try_command_effect = { KIND = $KIND$ }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_ai = yes } }
			if = {
				limit = { qpq_$KIND$_ai_acceptance_value > 0 }
				qpq_k_$KIND$_seal_from_scopes_effect = yes
				qpq_ai_command_seal_effect = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			scope:recipient = {
				add_character_flag = { flag = qpq_considering_proposal days = 30 }
				trigger_event = qpq_hub.50
			}
		}
	}
}
